title: Logos Zines
description: A group becomes a culture when it can see itself. Logos zines are where the movement does that: a record of what our activists are building, who they are helping, what they are running, and what they are learning on the way. Whatever we document becomes the direction of the practice, so each issue works as a mirror, a shared image of ourselves that people start practising toward.

A Simple Guide to Reformatting Society
